falsifiers.F1_cross_fleet_zero_clock: Zero-clock OS-event threshold firing (eventfd / kqueue+pipe / Win32 Event) fails to eliminate empty polling wakeups or fails to lower CPU/rail energy (including physical INA3221 VDD_CPU_SOC_MSS measured_j on Jetson AGX Thor) relative to 1,000 Hz clocked polling at 1% bursty duty.
falsifiers.F2_cross_fleet_attestation: Compiled Rust BLAKE3 (256-bit) + Ed25519 (64-byte RFC 8032) verification at 1 KiB and 16 KiB exceeds 100 us or 5 mJ per edge on any of the 5 fleet hosts.
falsifiers.F3_oracle_and_calibration_isolation: Any camp, enzyme V_gate, or calibration profiler accesses the 100 test tasks' held-out oracles prior to post-commit scoring, or the 15 calibration probes overlap the 100 test tasks.
falsifiers.F4_siloed_camp_ceiling_vs_des10: Any single siloed paradigm camp solo (C1-C10) matches DES-10 simultaneously on 100-task verified pass rate, 0% false-commit rate, and Coherence per Joule across both i9-13900H (reported_j) and Jetson Thor (measured_j).
falsifiers.F5_enzymatic_activation_barrier: Digital Enzyme binary IR + Rust BLAKE3+Ed25519 handoff fails to achieve >10,000x reduction in handoff latency and local host energy relative to Camp 9 natural-language prose serialization + live LLM re-parse.
falsifiers.F6_shared_host_and_drift_disclosure: Whenever a shared-host co-tenant lock is active (Jetson Thor GPU_ACTIVE) or 5.0 s pre/post quiet idle power drifts by >10.0%, single-window A2 net idle subtraction MUST be withheld while raw rail readings and counterbalanced paired deltas are preserved.
